title: 12-apps: messaging ts semantics — wall_clock_valid gating and ts=0 acceptance (18.1.1)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.1.1 Timestamp Semantics: senders SHOULD include ts only when their time provider reports wall_clock_valid=true; receivers MAY accept ts absent or ts=0 as 'time unknown'; TTL expiry comparisons need wall-clock, and clockless nodes SHOULD NOT enforce TTL expiry. No implementation evidence: Python validates ts type only (messaging.py:374-377); C msg struct has no ttl field (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/include/lichen/coap_msg.h:70-83); no wall_clock_valid signal anywhere. SH-level gap; file covers the whole timestamp/ttl semantic cluster. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-008/009.
